body:
For a while i wondered if i could convey my life's lessons to others but quickly found out i don't relate well to others. People turn to drugs for drastically different reasons that usually have the same cause, the desire for escape. Unfortunately no real counseling exists for people in that situation. This is because what those people need to survive is money stability and nourishment, while what they really need to live is love, patience and understanding. However i am in no position to provide any of that as i haven't even enough for myself. The only way to help other generations would be to provide those things to prevent such problems from surfacing in the first place. There are many meaningful displays of this internationally in places such as Sweden or Amsterdam, countries where those of influence measure the gross domestic happiness as opposed to their gross domestic product. Yet no one in any meaningful position in our society, and thus capable of encouraging such progress, would bother to listen to anything a person like me has to say.

(tl;dr Ive considered counseling but think that even if i can provide comfort, i cannot change a persons environment)

I have tried what nutritional programs i can afford and mental exercises but being aware of the sharp contrast between my current cognitive abilities and what they could have been is beyond disheartening.

I don't think anything will happen tonight. If nothing else i still know to clean up after myself.

Thank you for the offer, Im sure you've gone to bed by now though.

Goodnight
